# Screenshots Guide

To make your README more professional, add screenshots of your application.

## Recommended Screenshots

### Customer App Screenshots

1. **Home Page** - Landing page with hero section
   - Save as: `screenshots/customer-home.png`

2. **Menu Page** - Products with categories
   - Save as: `screenshots/customer-menu.png`

3. **Cart View** - Shopping cart with items
   - Save as: `screenshots/customer-cart.png`

4. **Checkout** - Payment and order confirmation
   - Save as: `screenshots/customer-checkout.png`

5. **Order History** - Past orders list
   - Save as: `screenshots/customer-orders.png`

### Staff Dashboard Screenshots

1. **POS System** - Order creation interface
   - Save as: `screenshots/staff-pos.png`

2. **Order Management** - Active orders view
   - Save as: `screenshots/staff-orders.png`

3. **Analytics Dashboard** - Sales statistics
   - Save as: `screenshots/staff-analytics.png`

4. **Product Management** - Add/edit products
   - Save as: `screenshots/staff-products.png`

5. **Table Management** - QR code generation
   - Save as: `screenshots/staff-tables.png`

## How to Add Screenshots

1. Create a `screenshots` folder in the root directory
2. Take screenshots of your deployed application
3. Save them with the names mentioned above
4. Update README.md with the image links

## Example README Update

Replace the "Screenshots" section in README.md with:

```markdown
## Screenshots

### Customer App

<table>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="screenshots/customer-home.png" alt="Home Page" /></td>
    <td><img src="screenshots/customer-menu.png" alt="Menu Page" /></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td align="center">Home Page</td>
    <td align="center">Menu Browsing</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="screenshots/customer-cart.png" alt="Cart" /></td>
    <td><img src="screenshots/customer-checkout.png" alt="Checkout" /></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td align="center">Shopping Cart</td>
    <td align="center">Checkout & Payment</td>
  </tr>
</table>

### Staff Dashboard

<table>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="screenshots/staff-pos.png" alt="POS System" /></td>
    <td><img src="screenshots/staff-orders.png" alt="Order Management" /></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td align="center">POS System</td>
    <td align="center">Order Management</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><img src="screenshots/staff-analytics.png" alt="Analytics" /></td>

  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td align="center">Analytics Dashboard</td>

  </tr>
</table>
```

## Tips for Good Screenshots

- Use a consistent browser window size
- Take screenshots at 1920x1080 resolution
- Avoid sensitive data in screenshots
- Use test/demo data
- Ensure good lighting and contrast
- Capture the full feature/page
